description: The export skeleton: format, destination and scope are validated and resolved; the rendering is `e5.7`. The payload states plainly that nothing was written.

scope.description: The resolved range: what was asked, the endpoints as short oids, how many commits, and the delta model the artefact would be written from (`delta`: the contract, its version, and each of the seven sections' state with the owner of every gap — or a stated absence with the remedy). `e5.7` renders it.

title: fathom export --json (skeleton)

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: ERROR
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: a rev that names nothing, an unimplemented verb, a rejected argument value

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: USAGE
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: clap rejected the command line (bad flag, unknown verb, missing value)

x-fathom-exit-codes.name: NOT_A_REPOSITORY
x-fathom-exit-codes.when: --root is not a git repository, or `.git` is unreadable
